chunks: There shall not inherit along with the mother, nor with the father, nor with the son, nor with the daughter, except for the husband and the wife.
And indeed the husband shall not be reduced anything from the half share when there is no child, nor shall the wife be reduced anything from the quarter when there is no child.
So if there is a child with them both, then for the husband is the quarter and for the wife is the eighth.

key_terms.الثُّمُن: the eighth (1/8) — the wife's reduced share when there is a child
key_terms.الرُّبُع: the quarter (1/4) — the wife's base share when there is no child, and the husband's share when there is a child
key_terms.النِّصْف: the half (1/2) — the husband's share when there is no child
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: child — includes both sons and daughters as children who affect spousal shares

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a husband and wife in Islamic law when there are children or parents?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes a fundamental principle of Islamic inheritance law: the spousal shares are protected and cannot be displaced by parents or children. When there is no child, the husband receives half and the wife receives a quarter; when there is a child, the husband receives a quarter and the wife receives an eighth. This ruling reflects the Quranic inheritance verses (4:11-12) and ensures that a spouse always retains a protected minimum share regardless of what other heirs are present.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz and someone else, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘There shall not inherit along with the mother, nor with the father, nor with the son, nor with the daughter, except for the husband and the wife;
and that the husband would not be reduced anything from the half if there does not happen to be a son, nor would the wife be reduced anything from the quarter when there does not happen to be a son.
So if there was a child for the two of them, so for the husband would be the quarter and for the wife an eighth’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa and a number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz and others from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘With the existence of a mother or father or son or daughter no one else inherits except the husband and wife.
The one-half share of the husband is not reduced if there are no children; and from one-fourth of a wife nothing is reduced if there are no children;
but if there is a child with them then one-fourth is the share of a husband and one-eighth is the share of a wife.’”
